CallSummary.description: An LLMCallRecord without its request and response bodies (the trace download has them).
CallSummary.title: CallSummary

evidence.description: Unit refs (<source_id>/<unit_id>) the claim rests on
evidence.title: Evidence

id.description: Short id such as c1; unique within the report
id.title: Id

likelihood_term.description: For judgments: the estimative term used, from the lexicon
likelihood_term.title: Likelihood Term

quotes.description: Verbatim spans of the cited units that support the claim
quotes.title: Quotes

deadline_at.description: When the discovery is failed if it has not ended, by the limit that applies (CRL-38, R-M17-27): `started_at` plus `worker.discovery_deadline_s` once the worker has claimed it (ended or not); otherwise `created_at` plus `worker.discovery_start_deadline_s`.
deadline_at.title: Deadline At

evidence.description: What in the draft (or missing from it) decided this
evidence.title: Evidence

reasons.description: One sentence each; what supports or undermines
reasons.title: Reasons

suggested_scope.description: A scope note the writer must include if thin
suggested_scope.title: Suggested Scope

supported.description: The sources support the value statement
supported.title: Supported

LatestRun.description: A project's newest run by `(created_at, id)` (M18 spec §7.1).

child_state.description: For a returned run, the state its revision ended in (null while it is being written); the same as a run summary's `review_child_state`.

decision.description: The reviewer's decision on the run, or null while it has none.

status.description: The report's status, once the run has one.

LatestRun.title: LatestRun

PackSummary.description:
One entry of `GET /api/packs` (spec §10.1): a pack directory as found, built-in packs
included. `name` is the directory name, which is what `load_pack` takes.
PackSummary.title: PackSummary

PriorReport.description:
An earlier accepted report as a run was given it (CRL-97): its key judgments, and whether
`pipeline.prior_judgments.budget_tokens` left it out (`cut`, oldest first).
PriorReport.title: PriorReport

PriorReportsRule.description:
How a rule reads when the run has the key judgments of its project's earlier accepted
reports (CRL-97); `Rule.with_prior_reports`.
PriorReportsRule.title: PriorReportsRule

ProjectView.description: A project and what the sidebar shows for it (M18 spec §7.1).

last_activity_at.description: The latest of the project's `created_at`, its sources' `created_at`, and its runs' `created_at` and `finished_at`.
last_activity_at.title: Last Activity At

latest_run.description: The project's newest run, or null when it has none.

reports_to_review.description: Completed runs with no decision, or whose return's revision ended without a report (failed, cancelled or not supported; R-M15-1).
reports_to_review.title: Reports To Review

reports_writing.description: Runs not in a terminal state.
reports_writing.title: Reports Writing

ProjectView.title: ProjectView

Quote.description: Words copied verbatim from one of the units a claim cites.

ref.description: The unit ref the words are copied from, one of the claim's evidence
ref.title: Ref

text.description: Words copied verbatim from that unit: one contiguous span, no ellipses
text.title: Text

Quote.title: Quote

ResolvedPack.description: What a run snapshots (spec §6.6). Rules are sorted by id so the hash is stable.
ResolvedPack.title: ResolvedPack

ReviewState.description:
What a reviewer decided about a completed run (spec §10.1), from its review events and the
reruns they created. A return whose rerun is live or completed wins over an accept: the rerun
supersedes the accepted report (R-M9-1). A rerun that ended any other way spent nothing
(R-M15-1): the latest event decides, and the run can be returned or accepted again.
ReviewState.title: ReviewState

RunPage.description: One page of a project's runs, newest first (keyset paging on created_at and id).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null when this page is the last.
next_before.title: Next Before

RunPage.title: RunPage

profile.description: The team profile the run used; null for the deployment's default.
profile.title: Profile

source_ids.description: The project sources the run used, in the run's order (source `src<n>` of its trace is the n-th). A source deleted since is left out.
source_ids.title: Source Ids

value_statement.description: The value statement the run was given.
value_statement.title: Value Statement

worker_gone.description: The worker that took the run is gone: its heartbeat is `worker.stalled_after_s` old or its worker row was deleted, so the run is not moving. It starts over when a running worker re-queues its job; a cancel ends it at once (CRL-49, CRL-69). False for a run that ended, and for one no worker has taken yet.
worker_gone.title: Worker Gone

RunSummary.description: One row of `GET /api/runs?project_id=`: enough to list a project's runs and open one.

review_child_state.description: The state the revision of a returned run ended in; null while it is still being written. Failed, cancelled and gate-rejected mean the return produced no report.

review_decision.description: The reviewer's decision on this run, or null while it has none.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunTrace.description:
`GET /api/runs/{id}/trace` (spec §10.1): the summary plus what the Process tab shows
(spec §10.3) — how each draft changed the one before it, and every model call.
RunTrace.title: RunTrace

already_in_project.description: True on an upload's or a Coglossa import's answer (200, not 201) when the project had this file already, by sha256: the source it has, and nothing was added (CRL-126). Always false in a list.
already_in_project.title: Already In Project

logout_url.description: The proxy's sign-out page (`auth.logout_url`); the web app shows Sign out only when it is set.
logout_url.title: Logout Url

max_iterations.description: The audit loop's revision rounds (`pipeline.max_iterations`); the web app starts a run with this unless the analyst changes it.
max_iterations.title: Max Iterations

info.summary: Standards-enforced intelligence report production with a full trace.
info.title: Corelata

carries a translation guide. Nothing is kept when the file cannot be parsed. With

(CRL-126).

The checks `corelata doctor` runs, from the API's own config file. The one route that
talks to the model servers (spec §10.1): it lists their models on every call, and sends a
test completion per model only with `probe=true`. Probing runs are shared by concurrent
callers and reused for 30 s (CRL-112), so repeated calls do not spend tokens.
